shelf.hints: Copy Enter · Paste Ctrl+Enter · Pin P · Take down S · Close Esc
shelf.empty.title: The board is empty
shelf.empty.body: Things you copy and screenshots you take get taped here. Pin the ones you want to keep.
shelf.paste.gone: The window you came from has closed, so nothing was pasted.
shelf.paste.elevated: That app runs as administrator, so Windows does not let Panopin paste into it. The item is on the clipboard: press Ctrl+V there.
shelf.paste.password: That is a password field, so nothing was pasted.
shelf.paste.failed: Pasting did not work. The item is on the clipboard: press Ctrl+V.
settings.title: Panopin Settings
onboarding.title: Welcome to Panopin
onboarding.intro: Panopin quietly keeps what you copy and the screenshots you take, and slides them in on a cork board when you need them.
onboarding.textNote: Text is collected too: everything you copy as text is saved on this PC until it expires.
onboarding.privacy: Everything stays on this PC and nothing is sent anywhere. Copies from password managers and content Windows marks as private are never saved.
onboarding.notVault: Panopin is not a password vault: saved items are not encrypted.
onboarding.linkPreviewsHelp: To show a page's title and picture, Panopin connects to that site. Off unless you turn it on.
